card.name: The word continued before "need"
card.fires_on: The word "continued" right after "evaluate the" or "determine the" in reassessment instructions, just before "need" for ongoing treatment.

modes.label: Opioid reassessment
modes.description: "continued" in the instruction to periodically reassess patients on an opioid to evaluate the continued need for opioid analgesics.
modes.example: Periodically reassess patients receiving BELBUCA to evaluate the<< continued>> need for opioid analgesics to maintain

modes.label: Maintenance treatment reassessment
modes.description: "continued" in the instruction to reassess patients to determine the continued need for maintenance treatment.
modes.example: Patients should be periodically reassessed to determine the<< continued>> need for maintenance treatment.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of need-type words (need, require), which is odd since "need" is the very next word.
card.plain: It marks the word "continued" in "evaluate the continued need for" treatment, in dosing reassessment instructions.
